meta.method: Read every source file (app/, components/, proxy, config, schema, migrations, data JSON); ran lint, tsc, vitest and a production build; served the build and drove it in headless Chromium at 375/768/1024/1280/1440px (screenshots, overflow, duplicate ids, landmarks, console errors).

status_values.needs-owner: business decision, not a code change

baseline.result: no horizontal overflow, no console errors; header overlap (DES-01), nested main (A11Y-07), 404 without main (A11Y-11)

issues.title: `tsc --noEmit` fails on a fresh checkout
issues.detail: RootLayout is typed with the global `LayoutProps<"/">`, which only exists after `next build`/`next typegen` has written .next/types. docs/ci-workflow.yml runs `npx tsc --noEmit` BEFORE `next build`, so CI fails on every push (reproduced: `error TS2304: Cannot find name 'LayoutProps'`).
issues.fix: Type children explicitly ({ children: React.ReactNode }) like app/(site)/layout.tsx does, and add an `npm run typecheck` script.

issues.title: Desktop header overlaps itself between 1024px and ~1440px
issues.detail: The nav links are absolutely centred over a flex row holding the logo badge, two phone numbers and three social icons. Below ~1440px there isn't room: at 1024px 'Home/About' print over the logo and 'Taxi/Contact' over the phone numbers; at 1280px 'Contact' collides with the phone numbers (confirmed in headless-Chromium screenshots).
issues.fix: Put the nav in normal flex flow, use the full desktop bar only from xl (1280px) with tighter side margins, and the hamburger menu below that.

issues.title: Closed mobile menu is still keyboard-focusable
issues.detail: The overlay is hidden with opacity-0 + pointer-events-none + aria-hidden, but its links and buttons stay in the tab order. Keyboard users below 1024px tab through 10 invisible controls; focus is not moved into the menu when it opens or back to the toggle when it closes.
issues.fix: Make the closed overlay `inert`, focus the close button on open and return focus to the toggle on close.

issues.title: Booking form has no visible keyboard focus
issues.detail: `.input`, `.select`, `.submit` and `.secondary` all set `outline: 0/none` with no :focus replacement, so a keyboard user cannot see which field or button is focused in the most important form on the site (WCAG 2.4.7).
issues.fix: Add :focus-visible rings (brand-gold border + outline) for inputs, selects and buttons.

issues.title: Dashboard 'New today' uses UTC midnight, not Cyprus midnight
issues.detail: `startOfToday.setHours(0,0,0,0)` uses the server's local zone (UTC on Vercel). Between 00:00 and 02:00/03:00 Cyprus time the count still includes yesterday's bookings. README explicitly forbids local-time date handling outside app/lib/timezone.ts.
issues.fix: Add startOfBusinessDay() to app/lib/timezone.ts (with a test) and use it.

issues.title: Phone numbers typed with a trunk 0 or full international prefix are mangled
issues.detail: The country code is blindly prepended: a UK visitor typing '07700 900123' is stored as '+4407700900123' (wrong number), and someone typing '+357 99 123456' becomes '+357+35799123456', which the schema rejects as invalid even though they typed a correct number.
issues.fix: Normalise the national part: accept a number that already starts with + or 00 as international, otherwise drop a single trunk '0' (except Italy, +39, which keeps it) before prefixing the dial code.

issues.title: Rate limit counts rejected attempts, locking real customers out
issues.detail: The 5-per-hour booking limit is consumed before validation and before the availability check. A customer who tries a few date ranges for a car that is already booked (each returns 'already booked') is blocked for an hour on the 6th try.
issues.fix: Validate first (pure CPU, safe to repeat), then rate-limit, so only well-formed requests that reach the database count.

issues.title: 'Book' in the price dialog scrolls back away from the booking form
issues.detail: bookTransfer() closes the dialog and smooth-scrolls to #booking, but the dialog's async 'close' event then calls triggerRef.focus(), which scrolls the page back to the 'See all prices' button (it sits below the form on the home page).
issues.fix: Restore focus with { preventScroll: true }.

issues.title: Accepting an overlapping reservation shows a generic error
issues.detail: Setting a rejected/expired car booking back to Pending/Accepted when its dates now overlap another booking violates the `no_overlapping_car_bookings` exclusion constraint. The admin just sees 'Could not update the status', with no hint why.
issues.fix: Share the exclusion-violation detector (move it to app/lib) and return 'This car is already booked for overlapping dates…'.

issues.title: Form errors are not tied to their fields or announced
issues.detail: Error paragraphs have no id/role and inputs have no aria-describedby, so screen readers neither announce errors nor read them with the field. After pressing 'Next' with errors, focus stays on the button.
issues.fix: Give each error an id, point the input's aria-describedby at it, mark errors role=alert, and focus the first invalid field after a failed step.

issues.title: Low-contrast labels in the booking form
issues.detail: Field labels, floating labels and the date hint use `color: grey` (#808080) on white = 3.9:1, below the WCAG AA 4.5:1 for small text.

issues.title: Hidden carousel slides contain focusable links
issues.detail: On phones the two inactive slides are aria-hidden but their 'Reserve this car' links remain tabbable — focus lands on invisible content.
issues.fix: Use `inert` on inactive slides.

issues.title: '/fleet' 'Reserve this car' button doesn't reserve
issues.detail: On /fleet the card CTA links to the car's detail page, which has another 'Reserve this car' button — the label promises a booking but costs an extra page and click.
issues.fix: Card title links to the detail page (keeps the SEO internal link); the CTA always goes to the booking form pre-filled with the car.

issues.title: Opening hours contradict each other
issues.detail: The site-wide meta description says 'Open daily 07:00–22:00'; site-config, the header, footer, JSON-LD and the Google listing say 07:30–22:00.
issues.fix: Build the description from siteConfig.hours.

issues.title: About page gives the wrong neighbourhood
issues.detail: 'based in Neapolis, Paphos' — the address on every other page and on the Google Business Profile is Poseidonos 7, Kato Paphos. Inconsistent NAP data also hurts local SEO.
issues.fix: Say Kato Paphos.

issues.title: Screen readers read every review twice
issues.detail: The marquee duplicates the 9 reviews to loop seamlessly; the copy is not hidden from assistive tech.
issues.fix: aria-hidden + inert on the duplicate half.

issues.title: Nested <main> on /admin/login
issues.detail: The admin layout already renders <main>; the login page renders another inside it (found by the headless check).
issues.fix: Use a <div> in the page.

issues.title: Animations ignore prefers-reduced-motion
issues.detail: The booking form title has an infinite pulsing dot and the success icon pops; neither respects reduced motion (the rest of the site does).
issues.fix: Disable both under prefers-reduced-motion.

issues.title: Step indicator label is ignored
issues.detail: aria-label on a plain <div> with no role is not exposed by screen readers.
issues.fix: Add role="group".

issues.title: Menu button mislabelled; redundant banner role
issues.detail: The hamburger is labelled 'Toggle menu' but only opens; `role="banner"` duplicates <header>'s implicit role.
issues.fix: Label it 'Open menu'; drop the redundant role.

issues.title: 404 page has no <main> landmark
issues.detail: Found by the headless check.
issues.fix: Wrap the content in <main>.

issues.title: Mobile-menu 'Book now' has no focus style
issues.detail: Only :hover is styled.
issues.fix: Mirror the hover state on :focus-visible.

issues.title: Both cross-fade photos are announced
issues.detail: The fading-out photo keeps its alt text, so screen readers can announce two photos for one card.
issues.fix: aria-hidden + empty alt on the inactive image.

issues.title: Large empty band above inner-page content
issues.detail: Inner pages add py-12/py-16 on top of the main padding that already clears the fixed header — ~176px of white before the first line on tablet (see /fleet at 768px).
issues.fix: Reduce the top padding of inner pages (bottom unchanged).

issues.title: Footer columns align inconsistently on phones
issues.detail: On mobile the brand block and the map are left-aligned but the contact column is centred.
issues.fix: Left-align the contact column at every width.

issues.title: Dead mobile styles in the 'why us' strip
issues.detail: The section is `hidden sm:block`, yet each item carries mobile-only pill styles (rounded-full, bg, shadow, ring) that are immediately reset at sm.
issues.fix: Remove the dead classes.

issues.title: FAQ hard-codes the airport fare
issues.detail: '€35' is typed into the answer; it will silently go stale when taxi-rates.json changes (it also feeds the FAQ rich result).
issues.fix: Read it from taxi-rates.json via fromPrice().

issues.title: Grammar: 'hold a full licence held for at least one year'
issues.fix: 'have held a full licence for at least one year'.

issues.title: Two different confirmation-time promises
issues.detail: Hero, booking intro and taxi page say 'usually within the hour'; the success screen says 'within a couple of hours'.
issues.fix: Use the same promise.

issues.title: Taxi tier labels overlap
issues.detail: Tiers are 10–12, 13–14, 15–16 in the logic, but labelled '10–12', '12–14', '14–16' — a group of 12 or 14 sees its size in two columns with different prices.
issues.fix: Label them 13–14 and 15–16 (keys and prices unchanged).

issues.title: Garbled copy: 'we will fit the right seat at no rush'
issues.fix: Rewrite the sentence (no price claim — the child-seat charge is still an open owner question).

issues.title: Unconfirmed business claims are still published
issues.detail: 'No deposit', 'free delivery', 'no late-night rate', 'same fare in the other direction' are stated on the site but listed as open owner questions in FOLLOWUP.md.
issues.fix: Business decision — left for the owner.

issues.title: Car and route pages lose their Open Graph description
issues.detail: Declaring `openGraph` in a page replaces the root object, so shares of /fleet/* and /taxi/* have a title but no description.
issues.fix: Pass the page description into openGraph too.

issues.title: JSON-LD is injected without escaping '<'
issues.detail: Three pages inline JSON.stringify(...) via dangerouslySetInnerHTML. All data is static today, but a '</script>' in seo.json, a review or a FAQ answer would break out of the script tag.
issues.fix: One serializeJsonLd() helper that escapes '<' as \u003c, used everywhere.

issues.title: Address duplicated in JSON-LD
issues.detail: The structured address is hard-coded separately from siteConfig.address, so the two can drift (Google compares them).
issues.fix: Keep the address parts in siteConfig and derive both.

issues.title: Leftover Geist font stubs
issues.detail: `const geistSans = { variable: "" }` is a placeholder for a removed font; globals.css still maps --font-sans/--font-mono to the undefined --font-geist-* variables, and the booking reference uses var(--font-geist-mono).
issues.fix: Remove the stubs and dead variables.

issues.title: ESLint warning: unused `index`
issues.detail: The only lint warning in the project.
issues.fix: Remove it.

issues.title: Two unused CSS modules
issues.detail: NavSweepButton.module.css and NavCircleButton.module.css are imported nowhere.
issues.fix: Delete them.

issues.title: Stale cache invalidation of public pages
issues.detail: Booking and status actions call revalidatePath('/') and ('/fleet') 'because availability badges changed', but the public pages show no availability any more — they are fully static. Each booking forces both pages to regenerate for nothing. /taxi also has `revalidate = 300` with nothing dynamic. README still describes the old behaviour.
issues.fix: Drop the public-page revalidations and the taxi revalidate; fix README.

issues.title: Deprecated zod 4 APIs
issues.detail: z.string().datetime(), z.string().email() and z.ZodIssue are deprecated in zod 4.
issues.fix: Use z.iso.datetime(), z.email() and z.core.$ZodIssue.

issues.title: Proxy guards a route that doesn't exist
issues.detail: '/admin/export' is protected and matched but there is no such route.
issues.fix: Remove it.

issues.title: Error boundary component shadows the global `Error`
issues.detail: `export default function Error({ error }: { error: Error ... })`.
issues.fix: Rename to ErrorPage.

issues.title: Misleading rate-limit comment
issues.detail: Says '5 failed logins' but every attempt, including successful ones, is counted.
issues.fix: Correct the comment.

issues.title: Misleading module name
issues.detail: 'placeholder-data' holds the real taxi page content.
issues.fix: Rename to taxi-content.ts.

issues.title: Duplicate element ids in the home page HTML
issues.detail: Each card sets id={car.id}. The home carousel server-renders the mobile and desktop layouts, so every featured car id appears twice before hydration. Nothing links to these anchors.
issues.fix: Remove the unused ids.

issues.title: OG image recomputes the cheapest daily rate
issues.detail: Duplicates fromDailyRate from fleet-data.
issues.fix: Import fromDailyRate.

issues.title: 'Cars out now' card opens the wrong tab
issues.detail: It links to 'Upcoming' (future pickups only); cars out now have pickups in the past.
issues.fix: Link to the 'Past' tab, which lists them.

issues.title: Unknown ?to= deep-link value pre-fills an impossible destination
issues.detail: The select shows blank and the user gets 'choose a destination from the list' on Next.
issues.fix: Only accept destinations that exist in the list.

issues.title: Client IP read from the spoofable header first
issues.detail: The first x-forwarded-for entry is client-supplied when not behind Vercel's proxy (e.g. self-hosting), letting a bot rotate IPs to dodge the limit. Vercel sets x-real-ip itself.
issues.fix: Prefer x-real-ip, fall back to x-forwarded-for.

issues.title: Redundant migration declares the wrong column type
issues.detail: It re-adds passengers/adminNotes/contactedAt with IF NOT EXISTS (all no-ops after the earlier migrations), and declares contactedAt as TIMESTAMP(3) while the schema says timestamptz. Harmless today.
issues.fix: Not changed: editing an applied migration breaks Prisma's checksum on the production database.

issues.title: Unused image assets
issues.detail: img/logo.png (1 MB), public/logo.png and public/logo-icon.png are not referenced anywhere (FOLLOWUP.md asks the owner about the logo).
issues.fix: Left for the owner to decide.
